Whole negative-quantifier phrase means certainty in neither of the two respects in this four-case context. Definite in neither respect is the entire sixth-definite phrase; splitting neither onto gnyis ka or ma alone would lose its quantifier scope. d3 is appropriate.

errata_verdicts.reason: All five refutation checks survive. Source Wylie and ACIP both contain the claimed reading; the same verse has myong mi byed and C05:173 explains skyes nas myong gyur (with apostrophe) as experience after rebirth. No independent parallel of this verse, duplicate record, registered conversion class, dictionary-supported myod variant, or failed count was found. TCS10:338 is an unrelated passage alternating myod yul and myong yul, not evidence that this verse was independently published with MYOD. Retain LOW/PROBABLE because no blockprint or independent witness to this verse was checked.
errata_verdicts.parallel_witness: No independent witness to this verse found in C16, P1 or the TCS corpus. C16:758 reads 'nyon mongs rab dang drag po dang' / 'Those are definite which involve fierce', identical to the different C05:179 verse; it does not contain the 171 line. TCS10:338 reads 'yang myod yul bde ba de gas chog cing, myong yul bde ba zhes pa' and English 'the object that you experience'; this is the separate Lama-practice/death-as-path passage. C16:756 repeats C05:169 exactly, and C16:757 repeats C05:170 Tibetan and prose with a different appended heading: '19 Deeds that Definitely Ripen' versus '55 Deeds Projected for Different Realms and Beings'. These are same-source course-packet reuses, not independent publications of 171.
